rows.grounds: plural adjective indicating a group beginning with Brahmā
first member of compound denoting the celestial realm; compounded with following token
second member of compound denoting inhabitants; together with preceding token forms 'heaven-dwellers'

items.question: Which divine beings remain perpetually present before the goddess?
premises: Brahmā is explicitly named as present.
Other beings beginning with Brahmā are included.
These beings are dwellers of the heavenly realm.
Their presence is described as continual.
items.inference: Brahmā and other celestial dwellers stand perpetually before the goddess.
uncertainties: The compound tridivaukasaḥ is represented as two separate tokens in the input.
items.plain_english: O goddess, Brahmā and the other dwellers of heaven always stand before you.
